2f3b20c.summary: Reacts to damage dealt to a card, called on every card in play. Handles syphon, poisonous, rage, cruelty, ecstasy, damage triggers, ambush reveal, low-life invulnerability and concussive stun. Adds effects and fires triggers.
comments: null damageInfo: the decompiler routes this to the NullReferenceException at the end
damage was absorbed or zero: nothing to react to
this card was the source of the damage: handle attacker-side traits
syphon: when this card deals Attack damage it heals its owner's hero (amount seems to be 1)
poisonous: Attack damage to a non-warlord minion adds a lethal poison-type effect to the victim
this card is the one that was damaged: handle rage
rage applies if the card has it by default, currently, or via a Rage enchantment: fire the Rage trigger
double rage: fire the Rage trigger a second time
cruelty: on its owner's turn, damaging a surviving enemy fires the Cruelty trigger
work out health after this hit (damage minus armour, at least 1) to test the ecstasy threshold
warn: a unit already waiting to die is still receiving damage triggers
fire the generic UnitDamaged trigger for this card
this card took the damage: stop praying and run self-only reactions
ambush is broken when the unit is hurt (state bitmask = in-play states)
player's own card at 10 or less health with the low-life flag becomes invulnerable
split by damage type: ability/normal damage vs attack/blast damage
attack or blast damage: fire UnitDamagedByAttack
concussive: if this card was the attacking card and has concussive, stun the damaged card for 1 turn
shared null-check failure target

needs the ecstasy trait by default and must survive the hit
threshold test: currently above the trait value but ending at or below it

clear the in-hand reflected frame, drop ephemeral, and store the current turn as turnPlayed
